text: Founded in 2001, in today's social change driven by science and technology, the major closely follows the market demand and industrial trends, and is committed to moving in the direction of globalization, frontier and science, with the goal of cultivating global-oriented e-commerce digital operation and innovation elite talents. Since 2018, the professional construction of e-commerce has focused on "e-commerce (digital operation and innovation)". The main discipline of this major is management science and engineering. The degree awarded is a Bachelor of Management Studies. The duration of study is 4 years, and the length of study is 3-6 years. Implement the major and minor system, and e-commerce students can minor in another major at the same time as the major within the number of years of study; This program has an honorary bachelor's degree, and the conditions for obtaining it are shown in the 2020 version of the training plan "Course Setting and Credit Time Allocation Schedule".
